label: Hurdles
_note: SPEC_PET_ARENA §6.4/§6.6 — the first multi-clause event, and the first with alternatives (run AND (jump OR play)), from poses that exist today. Rev.9: each hurdle is a GATE (run clamps at the line; the next answer — one rung harder, in the jump color — is the leap). 14 m spacing = seven gates (14..98) — with the scrolling camera (~28 m viewport) one or two are on screen at a time, the owner's phone framing: sized so a sprite-length of track fits comfortably between obstacles and a race costs seven hard questions.
